verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a REST integration path [skyvern-docs-1] for submitting a natural-language goal, starting URL and optional JSON schema [skyvern-docs-18, skyvern-docs-17]. It also documents cloud-hosted Chromium instances, so the caller doesn't manage a browser [skyvern-docs-5, skyvern-docs-13]. However, nothing in the pack shows how results come back, whether by polling a run-status endpoint or by registering a webhook, and no OpenAPI spec was found [skyvern-probe-3]. missing for 10: documented polling/run-status endpoint, documented registrable webhook callbacks, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted API flow.
